evidence_scope: Real SQLite close/reopen and production snapshot APIs. This is not process-kill, power-loss or resource qualification.

result.summary: Partial uploads survived reopening without becoming visible; one resumed exactly and the other was reclaimed in bounded steps.

observations.label: Unpublished uploads
observations.expected: 12 staged bytes; only the baseline published

observations.label: Recovered contents
observations.expected: baseline unchanged and resumed bytes exact

observations.label: Bounded cleanup
observations.expected: 2 chunks and 1 upload removed in at most 8 calls; no uploads remain
